label: D2 after an unrewarded previous trial (not when policy strongly favors a1)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 99.5% of mass; never fires when the reward input is 1). Phase+prev_reward alone: dev P 0.28, R 0.98, F1 0.44. Adding that the model logit choice at D2 is not strongly a1-favoring (choice < 2.8; it essentially never fires above that) raises F1 to 0.54 with mass recall 0.99. Precision stays low: within the predicate it fires on only about a third of steps. Magnitude is higher after runs of consecutive unrewarded trials (two unrewarded in a row covers 54% of mass with 38% of active steps), and it fires less often late in the episode (rate falls from 6% in trials 0-9 to 0.2% in trials 90-99; ep_trial<70 raises F1 to 0.61). This looks like a slow drift that the predicate does not capture. Does not fire at D1 or GO, or after rewarded trials. Uses only observed variables.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (D2: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, ?) and trial before (D2: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, a2 S2 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D2 & ep_dec=0, phase=D2 & ep_dec=1, phase=D2.
